**Fixed. Suite is green: `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, despite the comment above it saying tax should apply after the discount.

Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`. All 3 failures were this same bug.
